description: This file defines the Request class in the Laminas\Diactoros namespace, implementing the PSR-7 RequestInterface. It encapsulates HTTP request details and provides methods for constructing and retrieving request information.

classes.name: Request
classes.description: A class representing an HTTP request, immutable, with methods to access request data and headers.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes a new Request object with optional URI, method, body, and headers.

methods.name: getHeaders
methods.description: Returns an array of headers for the request, adding the Host header if missing and URL host exists.

methods.name: getHeader
methods.description: Returns an array of header values for a given header name, handling the Host header specially.
